A short truncation such as w[:-2] would likely be more diagnostic (more likely to stay in PB3 while still not a legitimate witness) but was not tested this run. Reported raw, not smoothed over. The remaining 2/26 rows (PC-unit, both windows) are the trivial f=w=k=fpp=[] case, not separately re-tested.
